description: Use when your principal wants signed proof that one asset you ship was cleared: a Rights Receipt (open standard rights-receipt/1) binding the file's SHA-256 to its license, intended use, verdict and duties, signed (keys at /.well-known/jwks.json) and committed to the ledger. Ship it as <file>.rights.json. Call with {"asset": {"sha256": "<64-hex sha256 of the file>", "kind": "font", "name": "Inter.ttf"}, "license": "OFL-1.1", "intended_use": {"commercial_use": true}}.

api_key.description: Deprecated: use Authorization: Bearer <key> (arguments can reach transcripts).

idempotency_key.description: Optional: a retry with the same key returns the first proof.

name: issue_rights_receipt
title: Issue a Rights Receipt for one asset
